aboutUs.headline: Leading M&E Engineering Company with Decades of Excellence
aboutUs.background:
IT Usaha Engineering Sdn Bhd is a leading engineering firm in Malaysia, specializing in Data Centre infrastructure and mission-critical electrical systems. With decades of industry experience and a proven track record of delivering more than 30 Data Centres nationwide, we support some of the most demanding clients in the digital ecosystem.

  Our services cover the full project lifecycle, from initial design and engineering to construction, testing, and facilities management. Backed by a highly skilled team of engineers, project managers, and technical staff, we offer expertise in mechanical and electrical (M&E) works, HT and LV systems, BMS, Security System, ELV installations, BIM modeling, CFD simulation, and ETAP – Energy Management Solution Software. Known for our strong safety performance, strong financial footing, and strategic partnerships with global technology providers, we deliver infrastructure that meets international standards for reliability, scalability, and efficiency.
aboutUs.vision: To be the No.1 MEP engineering solutions provider, recognized for our commitment to quality, sustainability, and client satisfaction in the Data Centre industry
aboutUs.mission: To design and implement cutting-edge MEP solutions that power the seamless operation of critical data centre environments by optimizing energy efficiency, uncompromising reliability, and long-term sustainability.
aboutUs.leadershipIntro: Meet the driving forces behind IT Usaha that made us what we are today, and continue to lead the team towards higher standards and performance.

leaders.name: Jeffrey Low Wei Keong
leaders.bio: Since 1997, our Chairman and Founder has been the driving force behind IT Usaha Engineering’s growth. Under his esteemed leadership, the company has successfully executed projects exceeding RM200 million in contract value across diverse development sectors — a testament to his vision, discipline, and unwavering commitment to engineering excellence.

leaders.name: Leong Choon Keong
leaders.bio: Our Managing Director has extensive experience in project planning, design, and management since 1998. Under his leadership, the company has delivered projects exceeding RM1 billion. We are committed to providing reliable, high-quality engineering and technology solutions with integrity, innovation, and excellence.

leaders.name: Ng Kim Han
leaders.bio: Since 2001, our Executive Director has overseen the overall management and development of IT Usaha, ensuring smooth operations and effective coordination across all departments. He is instrumental in building strong teams, streamlining processes, and maintaining high standards of performance. His commitment to quality and structured management practices supports the company’s alignment with ISO 9001:2015 standards.

aboutUs.milestonesIntro: Since 1997, every project and achievement has marked a step forward in our journey. Discover the key milestones that highlight our evolution from a local electrical contractor to a leading M&E solutions provider for mission-critical infrastructure.

milestones.body: IT Usaha Engineering was founded, specializing in M&E services.
Completed our 1st Data Centre Construction for Telekom Malaysia, KL.
Completed electrical services for Marina BS Tower 3, Singapore.
Completed Full Turnkey Data Centre construction for TIME DOT COM, Kuantan.
Completed Full Turnkey Cable Landing Station for TIME DOT COM, Pulau Pinang.
Supplied, installed, and commissioned Electrical Services at Four Seasons Place, Kuala Lumpur.
Completed Electrical LV works at AIMS Menara KL Data Centre Construction (IT Load Capacity: 5 MW).
Completed Cable Landing Station Infra Upgrade Project at Cherating, Kuantan.
Supplied and installed Electrical LV System for AIMS Cyberjaya Blk 1 (IT Load Capacity: 6 MW).
Completed M&E Fit-Out for Iskandar Puteri Data Centre (IPDC) (IT Load Capacity: 2.5 MW).
Critical Equipment Testing & Commissioning for AIR TRUNK JHB1, Johor Bahru.
Full Mechanical & Electrical System works for AIMS Cyberjaya Blk 1, 2 & 3 (IT Load Capacity: 24 MW).
Full Mechanical and Electrical system works for TM Nxera, Block 1 (IT Load Capacity: 16 MW).
Expanding Data Centre, Cable Landing Station, and Critical Infrastructure services with future-ready designs.
